head.description: base of skull / neck attachment point

notes: All visible neutral artwork is direct pixel extraction from source.png.
No secondary spring layer was created because no part offered clear motion value without adding separation risk.
Only a narrow hidden band behind the lower skull and upper neck opening was reconstructed for small head motion.
This skeleton has no eyelids. eyes_closed.png performs a source-aligned glow-off blink inside the detected socket regions.
